text: Given this context, the present study investigated whether an acute perturbation of sensory input, with experimentally induced blur, is sufficient to activate the homeostatic mechanisms required for NIBS-driven functional improvement. This is an important knowledge gap because prior standalone TBS studies in typically sighted individuals have almost exclusively been conducted under conditions of optimal vision, leaving the effect of acute degradation unknown.
source_label: Theta burst stimulation of the visual cortex does not alter contrast sensitivity under optically induced blur
